response.sql:
WITH per_rating AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(length) AS avg_length,
    AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_length) AS avg_per_rating_length,
  AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_per_rating_ratio
FROM per_rating;

assumptions.assumption: “Threshold set at 20.99” means replacement_cost is at least 20.99. Missing lengths are excluded by AVG(length); rental_rate and replacement_cost are non-null in the schema, and missing ratings form their own group if present.

alternatives.interpretation: If the threshold means strictly greater than 20.99, use this filter instead.
